desc: Sheldon, in a red shirt, laughs hard and swings back and forth on the chair at the canteen while sitting with Howard and Leonard.
Raj enters the apartment, where everyone sits and eats, with a redheaded woman.
Raj takes the purse from a redheaded woman in a dark blue blazer.
Sheldon, in a grey shirt, hands Amy, in a purple sweater next to him, food wrapped in foil.
Amy laughs and drinks a sip of tea out of a blue cup, while sitting next to Penny, who holds a green cup.
Penny slides her hand from cheek to neck while holding a green cup on the couch, next to Amy.
Sheldon, in a blue superman shirt, slams a comic book down on the table.
Penny, in suit and pink shirt, walks into Emily's office carrying a briefcase and coffees.
Penny puts her briefcase and the coffees on the examination table in Emily's office.
Emily sits down on the chair holding a clipboard, next to the examination table with Penny's briefcase.
Emily looks at the time on her watch while sitting on the chair in front of Penny, who is holding a pink package from the briefcase.
Penny, in a suit and pink shirt, waves her hand down with resignation and closes the briefcase.
Penny opens the briefcase and hands Emily a flyer.
Emily puts down a clipboard and pen on the examination table and stands up.
Leonard puts his head down and rubs his forehead while sitting at the desk, as Raj and Penny talk beside him.
Sheldon stands at the kitchen counter with one hand resting on the lid of a water bottle, then laughs, turning his head to the side.
Penny switches which hand she's using to hold the wine glass while standing at the kitchen table with Amy, in a white and red striped sweater.
Amy puts a finger on Penny's lips and then starts stroking Penny's cheek while she has a disgusted look on her face.
Leonard and Penny, eating ice cream, walk up the stairs, passing a bike.
Bernadette, in a blue floral dress, reaches out and holds Howard's hand to comfort him while they are eating dinner.
Amy is pouring something from the orange kettle into a yellow cup, while talking to Sheldon, who sits at the kitchen counter.
Amy stands at the kitchen counter holding a plate with cookies, staring at Sheldon, before she puts it down.
Penny opens the front door to her apartment, where Raj and Emily are standing outside.
Penny puts her hand on Raj's shoulder as he stands between her and Emily.
A wide shot of Stuart, Howard and Bernadette sitting down together in a cozy, antique-filled living room.
Bernadette, in a blue blazer, briefly puts a hand on Howard's arm while they sit on the light floral couch.
Howard gets up from the couch in a rush and walks up the indoor stairs.
Raj hugs Penny, then Emily does the same and they leaves the apartment.
A shot of Penny and Emily separated by the door before they walk apart.
A wide shot of Howard, Raj, Sheldon, and Leonard sitting in the living room, all reading comics.
